title: OVERWATCH-ADVERSARIAL — 2-hop effort-projection chain across THREE families in ONE fresh session (no seed, no cell, no expected_red): the session cursor is pinned hermetically to ultra (config_patch models/default_reasoning_effort=ultra — idempotent, the live value is already ultra as of the 2026-09-18 re-verification). Code-derivable chain (provider.rs:138-145 wire remap + multi_agent_mode hook; reasoning_effort.rs:11 apply_supported_effort; remote_config/manager/mod.rs:572 project_effort; model_switch.rs Preserve arm stores the projected value back): HOP-1 sol (family codex, mAV2 on): cursor ultra -> wire effort max + the PROACTIVE multi_agent_mode hook (ultra local effort -> proactive text). HOP-2 /model qwen3.8-27b (family codex->qwen = FAMILY SWITCH -> preemptive compact, no effort on the compact per r3r req-003): carried ultra not in the qwen menu {xhigh,medium,low} -> projection = TARGET DEFAULT xhigh; no hook (hook gated on the codex dialect, client.rs:1967 model_family=='codex'). HOP-3 /model gpt-5.6-terra (family qwen->codex = FAMILY SWITCH -> preemptive compact): carried xhigh not in the terra menu {low,medium,high,max,ultra} (EXPLICIT menu, config.toml re-verified 2026-09-18 — the slug-inference era note is STALE) -> projection = TERRA DEFAULT low; hook = EXPLICIT_REQUEST_ONLY flavor (codex family, non-ultra local effort). PREDICTED: every pin GREEN — the first live pin of the R6/effort-seam contract across three families. STOP-AND-REPORT (house rule): a 400/503 final on the terra boundary (the M-1 'Unexpected reasoning effort' class or a new phrasing), a wire effort OUTSIDE the pinned chain (raw ultra/max on a qwen turn = the R5 leak class), the multi_agent_mode literal on a qwen request (hook-gate lapse), or an acp_error. RE-PIN 2026-09-22 (overwatch-adversarial, run 20260922T004829Z): original pins predate apex-ayl.86 PROACTIVE-ULTRA-1 (b765b8d, 2026-09-19; case last touched 2026-09-18). Post-.86 design (provider.rs module doc, R-UNIFIED-ITEM + R-MENU-DERIVED, verified at ca31564): (a) the multi_agent_mode item rides EVERY family's every responses request — codex renders the bare keyword, other families the expanded sentence; mode text is effort-derived (cursor ultra -> proactive), NOT family-gated. (b) the session effort cursor is INHERITED across /model switches (model_switch.rs handle_set_session_model carries sampling_config.reasoning_effort; no projection write-back exists) — egress projects per target: qwen (no ultra in menu) -> menu-derived xhigh (R5 leak guard HELD: no raw/max/ultra on the qwen wire); terra (menu advertises ultra) -> ultra valid -> codex-frozen wire max + proactive. Observed 20260922T004829Z matches the design exactly. p2_no_hook -> p2_hook_expanded (expanded proactive sentence expected on qwen); p3_wire_low -> p3_wire_max; p3_no_max dropped.

steps.note: WIRE READ (recon_note, non-scoring): the three per-family turn requests are the fixture — req bodies for gpt-5.6-sol (hop 1), qwen3.8-27b (hop 2, post family-switch compact), and gpt-5.6-terra (hop 3, post family-switch compact). The scored pins assert the effort remap chain (max -> xhigh -> low) and the hook presence/absence (proactive on sol, none on qwen, explicit_request_only on terra). A coordinator review over the captured req bodies confirms the verbatim developer-item hook text per family.
